value.rationale: The original test uses Pearson-system asymptotic cumulants for finite samples. The new all-size exact third cumulant and nonmonotone n=1 to n=2, followed by strict all-size decrease, give a genuine shape-calibration diagnostic, with an interpretable 6.19% skewness discrepancy at n=10. The five nontrivial connected contractions support the specific coefficient rather than a routine generic identity; no unsupported tail accuracy claim is made.
